title: Xeet fanat tan asta
intro: Qaleela buxaaxil weeloysen baaxol, farmoyti Yallih gabat le astootih mujiza luk temeete. Sinam sumaq esserteeh, oson maqar le xaak gineenit geenih. takkay immay ken kaxxiina ken miraaciseh maabitina sadak, ken sarrimaane muhri.
clues: Anu qaleelal bicsen buxaaxil mannoowa mara fan ruube.
oson yoo gexkalooten asta baahuh, tonnal anu gaali xaak murtusse.
Anu gaali currik yaaqubeenim keenih amriseeh, tet biyaake waanam keenih amrise.
oson ammirtime waanam kee gaali yi maabitina sadak.
Anu woo digaala sidiica ayrok lakal amaateleemih aysixxige.
saaku, caylale bakaq ken bayseh, takkay immay yoo kee yi kataysis catneh.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
